This is close pointwise prior coverage; it must not be represented as new index formulas. The final claim is the separate global optimization of their nontrivial quotient and unique maximizer, neither of which is stated in the inspected source Theorem 2, Corollary 3 or older index theorem. Symbolic derivative sign analysis supplies the additional uniform inequality. Targeted searches found no published standalone ratio-optimization theorem, but the fact that both source profiles determine R implicitly is a significant originality limitation.
